alias_convention: Each aliases object maps an accepted complete cell to its canonical cell. No substring or semantic-prose matching.

output_contract.row_count: One per officially listed version through the observation date
output_contract.NONE: Only operative_assumption, for established absence of a named requirement; not absence of an erratum
output_contract.UNKNOWN: Missing or ambiguous non-key evidence; retain version row; blocks a complete reference oracle

scoring: Use the supplied generic parser, Item-F1, Row-F1 and P.O.A. unchanged. Apart from its Unicode NFKC, whitespace and Markdown normalization, apply only the explicit complete-cell aliases above. All fields are strings; the symbolic rank is not a rounded numerical measurement. No automatic case folding, archive-URL normalization, inferred aliases, or sorting of predictions.
